name: Magical Hair
body:
A supernatural event has left its mark on you via your hair, allowing you to utilize a remnant of its power so long as your locks remain unmarred.

Prerequisite(s): Race with natural hair (GM’s discretion).

Benefit(s): Choose a single hair color from the list below. You may cast each of the listed spells once per day as a spell-like ability. Your caster level is equal to your total Hit Dice, and you may choose to have your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma act as your ability modifier for this spell-like ability’s saving throw (if any); once made, this choice cannot be changed.

You lose access to this feat’s spell-like abilities if your hair is ever shaved off or if it’s dyed another color. If completely shorn, your hair regrows in one week. Illusions that change your hair color (such as disguise self or invisibility) do not prevent you from using this feat, but polymorph effects do unless your polymorphed form retains your chosen hair color.

A feat allowing a spellcaster to use an enemy’s full name to intimidate them is definitely in the right place here.

Black (antipaladin)—bane, death knell, murderous command
Blonde (paladin)—bless, liberating command, positive pulse
Blue (summoner)—mount, protection from chaos/evil/law/good (choose one), summon minor monster
Brunette (ranger)—blend, hunter’s howl, tracking mark
Gray (medium)—calm spirit, object reading, unseen servant
Green (mesmerist)—detect charm, memory lapse, remove fear
Orange (bloodrager)—break, magic weapon, spiked armor
Pink (bard)—ear piercing scream, negative reaction, true skill
Red (druid)—charm animal, pass without trace, shillelagh
White (cleric)—ceremony *, divine favor, shield of faith

Special: The magic of this feat is difficult to remove from yourself, doubling the cost of retraining this feat for another. Retraining this feat does not change your hair color, only removing the magic associated with it.

This feat cannot be taken if you have the white-haired witch archetype.

*Choose two domains whose ceremonies you can also perform. If you have access to clerical domains from another source, these choices must match those. Any alignment domains you select must match your own alignment.

Note: Each color is associated with a specific class spell list, from which it draws three 1st-level spells. Each spell list is parenthetically noted so that GMs wishing to add other hair colors to this feat can more easily differentiate the spells associated with them. For example, purple hair might be indicative of psychic magic, choosing mindlink, psychic reading, and see alignment—all 1st-level spells from the psychic spell list—for its associated spells.
